director.title: A Carnegie Hall performance, thoughtfully prepared.
director.audience: Discussion draft for the Wando High School band program
director.intro: For a concert program, the value of a destination performance begins before the first note and continues after the final bow. Troen’s March 3 Carnegie Hall event offers a setting for a focused conversation about musical preparation, student growth, and a memorable ensemble experience.
director.fit_heading: Why this conversation may fit Wando
director.fit_text: Wando’s documented concert-band program and historical Midwest Clinic appearance make the educational emphasis relevant. This is a research-based starting point, not an indication of Wando’s interest or travel plans.
director.support_heading: Make room for the music and the planning
director.support_text: The shared brochure describes an assigned event director and backstage support. A group-specific proposal would clarify the festival inclusions, travel responsibilities, approval needs, and payment terms together.
director.next_text: Explore whether the March 3 date, ensemble goals, and trip needs align. If they do, the next useful document is a tailored proposal that makes the educational experience and travel scope clear.
director.footer: Discussion draft • September 10, 2026 • Not issued to Wando

situations.next: Prepare an educational summary and a scoped trip proposal, with assumptions easy to see.
steps: Proposal
Draft the event experience, group needs, and travel scope; leave unapproved prices unquoted.
School approval
Provide a short educational rationale and identify the approval step; approval is not assumed.
Contract and payment
State the agreement and payment milestones in the eventual offer; no agreement or payment is recorded.
Travel suppliers
Check transport and accommodation feasibility before promising arrangements.
Final coordination
Carry confirmed numbers, rooming, and the performance schedule forward when the trip progresses.

situations.label: School approval takes longer
situations.heading: Keep the next decision manageable.
situations.next: Prepare a concise approval summary and review any proposed supplier holds before they become commitments.
steps: Proposal
Keep the latest proposal version and clearly mark which terms still need confirmation.
School approval
Focus on the decision-maker’s actual information need; do not label the group approved.
Contract and payment
Review timing against the proposed terms. Do not record a signed agreement or paid deposit.
Travel suppliers
Recheck any proposed hold or release dates with the supplier; none are invented here.
Final coordination
Defer detailed rooming and final participant work until the trip has a clearer basis.
